card.name: Table numbers after the word Table
card.fires_on: The digit that gives the number of a table, right after "Table" or "TABLE" in a drug label. It also fires on digits in section numbers like 5.14.

modes.label: Table number

modes.label: Section number digits
modes.description: A digit within a numbered heading such as 5.14 in a report outline.
